UDR 0/0 → Firewall deny-all

span.p: Backend network: no Internet route in either direction

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
aks-<env>-<x>-sf (optional, the last option,
built with the first approved exception)
own VNet · AKS LTS · Premium tier · the exposure's zones
fixed-size node pools in AZ 1, 2, 3 (no autoscaling)
network isolated (outbound type none) · Azure CNI (VNet)
no Gateway API, no Ingress:
internal LB Services, TLS by the application

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
Azure PaaS: the first choice for data, private endpoints only
Azure SQL / PostgreSQL (zone-redundant)
Storage (ZRS) · Service Bus · Event Hubs · Cosmos DB
ACR Premium (zone-redundant), one per exposure
Key Vault per isolation zone (app secrets)
+ the exposure's platform Key Vault (certificates, keys)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Frontend network of the exposure's subscription: stateless clusters, one per availability zone

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center; width: 360px;

span.p:
aks-<env>-<x>-sl-az1
own VNet (VNet encryption) · all nodes in AZ 1
the exposure's zones: int-fi, int-se or ext-fi, ext-se
Azure CNI Pod Subnet · Gateway API, HTTPS only
≥ 2 replicas per app · HPA / KEDA · cluster autoscaler

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 360px; text-align: center;

span.p:
aks-<env>-<x>-sl-az2
own VNet · all nodes in AZ 2
identical apps and configuration

records kept by ExternalDNS in the cells, moved by the migration workflow
